description: Master of weapon switching. Adapts to any situation by having the right weapon for the right moment. Rewards smooth transitions between weapons.

skills.name: Sheath and Strike
skills.description: Swap to another weapon and immediately attack with it. The fluid motion makes the strike more accurate.
skills.ai_instruction: Swap actor's equipped weapon to another weapon in their inventory. Make physical attack roll (1d20 + Strength modifier + Dexterity modifier) vs target AC — uses both modifiers for accuracy. On hit deal weapon dice + Strength modifier damage (Strength modifier only for damage). Call apply_damage on hit. Narrate the smooth weapon transition. On crit: max weapon die + roll + Strength modifier.

skills.name: Arsenal Strike
skills.description: Attack with your current weapon then immediately swap and strike again at reduced damage.
skills.ai_instruction: Make physical attack roll (1d20 + Strength modifier) vs target AC for first attack. On hit deal weapon dice + Strength modifier damage. Then swap to another weapon in inventory and make a second attack roll (1d20 + Strength modifier) vs target AC. On hit deal half of first hit's damage (round down). Call apply_damage twice if both hit. Narrate the aggressive weapon swap. Each hit independently can crit.

skills.name: Weapon Rhythm
skills.description: Passive. Each weapon swap this turn builds combat rhythm, increasing attack accuracy. Stacks up to 3, expires at start of next turn.
skills.ai_instruction: Passive skill. Each time actor swaps weapons this turn apply one Rhythm stack (max 3 stacks). Each stack adds +1 to all attack rolls this turn. Rhythm stacks expire at the start of actor's next turn — reset to 0. Track stacks as a status effect count. Narrate growing combat momentum with each swap.
